open_points.subject: Artifact type vocabulary and imported pointers
open_points.text: “The first release declares one: `estimate` by PresuPro” conflicts with the import bringing projects “with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept), links intact” and M05 requiring every pointer’s type and owner service to come from the declared vocabulary.
open_points.question: What happens when an imported project contains a pointer whose type is not `estimate`, or whose recorded owner service is not PresuPro?
options: Grandfather the imported type and owner service without adding them to the publishable vocabulary
Add every imported type and owner-service pair to the declared vocabulary
Transform or discard those pointers during import
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the whole import because every ArtifactPointer must satisfy the declared vocabulary and the import is atomic.
